title: A door-machine change that fails is never shown, so a lapsed member can keep getting in
what: When the admin app tells a gym door machine to add or remove a member and the machine never answers, the server tries 5 times and then marks the change as failed, saying it is kept for the owner. But the owner's machine list shows only when the machine was last heard from and today's refused and unknown punches; it never shows failed changes. A member whose plan ended can keep opening the door, or a member who just renewed can stay locked out, and nobody can see why. The daily check of who may come in also runs only when a desk opens the admin app, so on a day no desk opens it, nothing is sent. Not live yet (the door machine part is hidden).
expected: Failed machine changes are shown to the owner with the member's name and a Try again, and the daily who-may-come-in check runs on the server even when no desk is open.
how_often: whenever a door machine is offline for about an hour
fix_line: Show failed door-machine changes on the machines page and run the daily check from the server

title: Forgot PIN: pressing Save again after a lost answer says the code is no good, though the new PIN was set
what: After the WhatsApp code is checked, the new PIN is saved and the code is used up in the same step. If the answer is lost on a weak line and the person presses Save again, the server now refuses the used code, so the person is told the code is bad and may ask for a new WhatsApp code, while the new PIN already works. Not live yet.
expected: Saving the same new PIN again with the same code answers as done, so the person simply signs in.
fix_line: Treat a repeat of the same PIN with an already-used code as success

items.reason: these database files hold no recording or timer; heart rate, rest timer and workout clock live on the phone and watch
